{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''CNLink''', also known as a '''linked droid/computer system''', was a technology used to link [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] systems, allowing them to perform shared tasks with the efficiency of a single being possessing their various skills. The unmanned [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Tech 4 PDV]] [[Message pod|messenger pod]] was "crewed" by a CNLinked [[A/E computer|Analysis/Encoding Computer]], [[I2AM|I2-AM3]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astrogation droid]], and [[I2-CG droid/Legends|I2-CG]] [[storage and transceiving droid]].<ref name="The Evacuation of Jatee">{{WEGCite|story=The Evacuation of Jatee|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
CNLink was first mentioned in the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook written by [[Greg Gorden]] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
